remarks.simplePara: Bulk update of the responsible partner company name after the reorganization of the technical data department. Apply to the whole A350X common source database.

updateInstructions.para: Replace the element text with "AIRBUS S.A.S. — Technical Data and Services". Apply to every data module of the A350X model identification code, all issues in work and all released issues that are re-issued after this date.

Add a quality assurance element with an unverified child to every data module status that has none. A data module without a quality assurance statement fails the delivery check of the receiving system.
Remove the attribute. The delete change type is no longer permitted by the business rules; deleted content is removed at issue instead of being marked.
